scenes.title: Purpose
scenes.narration: It extracts key frames from video clips using ffmpeg, computes dense vector embeddings, builds a fast Faiss vector index.

beats.say: It extracts key frames from video clips using ffmpeg, computes dense vector embeddings, builds a fast Faiss vector index.
beats.caption: What it is: It extracts key frames from video

sources.text: It extracts key frames from video clips using ffmpeg, computes dense vector embeddings, builds a fast Faiss vector index, and searches video segments using natural language queries.

on_screen.content:
Frame Extraction: vidsearch.frames samples video keyframes with ffmpeg.
Embedding: vidsearch.embed generates normalized vector embeddings.
Indexing: vidsearch.index writes vectors into a Faiss cosine index.
